name: The fork rest
description: The last lamp on the hunters' trail, where the Waykeepers' road stops and the old folk's stones take over. A roadside rest with a lamp cairn pair at its trail mouth, an Even Court waystone at the yard's road corner, and across the road the thread they strung round the dying stand. Sergeant Torsten keeps the mouth beside the Wayward Watch; two sentinels keep the stone and say one line each.

signs.title: THE FORK REST
lines: the stone keeps the mile past it
